snippet.title: THIEF'S SHELTER - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
THIEF’S SHELTER is a psychological adventure where the world mirrors a crumbling mind. Nothing stays still, and even your own thoughts can’t be trusted. THIEF'S SHELTER unearths buried trauma, twisted ambitions, and the inhuman forces pulling the strings behind it all. Your investigation is intertwined with Detective James' personal struggles, such as the artificial dementia along with its effects.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430930/THIEFS_SHELTER/
